So what did they do, they reduced the weight of copper in the money and minted more coinage of lesser quality. Prices inflated further. Eventually the abandoned the policy and returned to minting coinage with the proper weight of copper, they found prices stabilized regardless of how much new money they created. As long as the quality of the newly created money was consistent, prices did not inflate. This is quality theory of money.
